summary.one_liner: A curated "awesome" list of PostgreSQL software, libraries, tools, hosting providers and learning resources.
summary.what_it_does: This is a link collection rather than a software project, organized by topic: high availability, backups, GUI clients, CLI tools, server forks, monitoring, extensions, work queues, optimization, utilities, language bindings, managed hosting (PaaS), Docker images and Kubernetes operators. A second section covers resources such as tutorials, blogs, books, documentation, newsletters, podcasts, videos and community channels. Each entry is a one-line description, and many entries are marked "(Commercial Software)" to distinguish paid products from open-source ones. The list is open to contributions via pull requests or issues.
use_cases: find a PostgreSQL GUI or CLI client
pick a backup or replication tool for Postgres
find monitoring and query-tuning tools for Postgres
locate Postgres learning materials and community channels
notable: Covers the full PostgreSQL ecosystem from HA and backups to Kubernetes operators and hosted services
Flags commercial products explicitly with '(Commercial Software)'
Links to large extension catalogues such as pgxn and community extension listings
Includes a resources section with tutorials, books, newsletters, podcasts and community channels
Inspired by awesome-mysql and linked from awesome-python under Database Drivers
caveats: Link list only; entries are not verified and some are marked obsolete (e.g. wal-e) or commercial
Entries are contributed by the community and may become outdated
